words: The player's user ID. The first of the four identity items.
All four items checked again in this chat. A check from a previous chat never counts.
The Zyra BO shows only the last 4 digits of the phone number. You verify against those.
The temporary password you generate after the reset. The member replaces it with his own at first login.
The Zyra back office, where you verify the member and reset the password.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Is this a Zyra password reset?
items: The member is on a ZYRA brand
He cannot log in or has forgotten his password
He asks for help
tour.done: All three: verify the four items first.
tour.notYet: This SOP covers ZYRA brands only.

tour.label: Verify
tour.title: Four items, all must pass
items: UID
Registered name
Phone number (match the last 4 digits in the BO)
Registered bank name and bank account number
tour.done: All four passed in this chat: reset.
tour.notYet: Any item missing or wrong: no reset.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Five steps
items: Verify the 4 items
Fresh, in this chat. All four must pass.
Reset
In the Zyra BO: reset and generate the random password.
Give it
Send the temporary password to the member on Livechat.
Confirm login
Ask him to log in with it and confirm it worked.
Own password
He creates his own new password at first login.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Three hard stops
items: Reset without complete, fresh verification of all four items.
Rely on a verification from a previous chat.
Keep or reuse the temporary password.

tour.label: Reset gate
tour.title: Can you reset now?
tour.q: Have all four items passed a fresh check in this chat?
tour.yes: Reset in the Zyra BO, give the random password, confirm the login, then the member sets his own.
tour.no: No reset. Complete the verification first.

pool.q: UID, name and phone match. The bank account number he gives does not. What do you do?
o: Reset, three out of four is enough
No reset: all four items must pass
pool.why: Step 1: all four must pass. No reset without complete verification.

pool.q: You verified this member in a chat yesterday. Today he asks for a reset again. What first?
o: Verify all four items again in this chat
pool.why: Fresh verification each chat; never rely on a previous one.

pool.q: How do you verify the phone number in the Zyra BO?
o: Match it against the last 4 digits the BO shows
Ask for a screenshot of his SIM
pool.why: The BO shows the last 4 digits of the phone for verification.

pool.q: Which bank detail is part of the four items?
o: Registered bank name and bank account number
pool.why: Item 4: registered bank name and bank account number.

pool.q: After the reset, what do you give the member?
o: A password you choose and keep for next time
pool.why: Steps 2 and 3: generate the random reset password and give it to the member. It is temporary.

pool.q: You gave him the temporary password. What next?
o: Ask him to log in with it and confirm it worked
pool.why: Step 4: ask the member to log in and confirm a successful login.

pool.q: He logged in with the temporary password. What must happen now?
o: He creates his own new password
You set a new one for him
pool.why: Step 5: the member replaces the temporary password at first login.

pool.q: A second member has the same problem. Can you give him the temporary password you made earlier?
o: No: never keep or reuse a temporary password
Yes, if both are Tier V
pool.why: Guards: never keep or reuse the temporary password.

pool.q: A ZYRA member says he forgot his password. What is your first action?
o: Verify UID, registered name, phone and bank details
pool.why: Verification is the mandatory pre-reset gate.
